head: Windows 11 Photos app gets Adobe-powered Expand and object removal
dek: Microsoft's Photos app on Windows 11 will get Adobe-made tools to expand a photo past its edges, rotate without cropping, change an object by typing and erase things; testing starts in December.
details: You'll also be able to send a photo to Adobe Express to keep designing there. Windows Latest worries it could lead to upsells, as Edge's Acrobat-based PDF reader asks users to start a free trial. The preview reaches Windows Insiders in December.
where: Windows 11 Photos, Insider preview from December
means: Bigger photo edits come to the free Photos app, with Adobe's name on them.
todo: Nothing to do yet; when it arrives, check whether a tool needs an Adobe account before you use it.
